tasks.label: Generate pdf from tex
tasks.command: mkdir -p "${workspaceFolder}/out" && cd "${workspaceFolder}/paper" && /Library/TeX/texbin/lualatex -output-directory=../out -interaction=nonstopmode cycles-through-1-qn1.tex && /Library/TeX/texbin/lualatex -output-directory=../out -interaction=nonstopmode cycles-through-1-qn1.tex && mv -f ../out/cycles-through-1-qn1.pdf . && bash "${workspaceFolder}/.vscode/reload-skim.sh" "${workspaceFolder}/paper/cycles-through-1-qn1.pdf"
